title: Grateful Dead Live at Oregon Country Fair on 1982-08-28
lineage: 1st Generation Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A)> Tascam DA-3000 (24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2022 > TLH flac2496
source: Master Audience Cassettes; 3 x Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5; Jim Vita's 1st Generation Cassettes

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience stereo recording with tight bass and superb separation, capturing a classic 1982 show.
ai_review.review: The Jim Vita Sennheiser field recording is praised as “most excellent,” delivering crystal‑clear stereo imaging and a notably tight bass response despite the challenges of an outdoor venue. Reviewers note that this release surpasses earlier lower‑quality audience tapes and provides a fresh, high‑fidelity listen to a well‑known concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review, but it is overwhelmingly positive about the recording quality and implies a solid performance; lack of explicit show rating keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tight bass response, excellent stereo separation for an outdoor setting; reviewer calls the Sennheiser capture “most excellent” compared to previous field recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers only reference overall quality of the known show.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is tight, noted as a highlight by the reviewer.
